text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gol-gol-gol-gol-Gold Shi—
Whoa! Someone's here!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I am.
This is my room too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? You got the spawn rate of a living
giant squid, so don't act so smug!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I mean, just the two of us in a room feels
suuuper awkward!
Let's head out and have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, as spontaneous as ever.
—Sure, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, we just let our legs carry us all the way here, but...
What should we do next?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey SteGo, there's only one thing to do
when you hit up a stylish street, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yup, a beetle battle!
Let's dye the whole town tree-sap color with a heated duel!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun, but...
Unfortunately, I don't have any beetles on me.
Alright, let's head to the mountains to catch some.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? Guess we gotta.
Beetles are a maiden's basic manners, SteGo.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Feels nice and refreshing here.
Now then, where are the beetles—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Emergency, SteGo! Pistachio market crashed!
The maiden economy is in utter chaos! Total pandemonium!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hmm, and what does that mean exactly?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It means... the era of beetles is over!
The new meta is deserted island tours in a washbasin!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that sounds good too!
Though paddling that sounds pretty exhausting...
Alright, let's hitch a ride on a fisherman's boat I met before.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh. Fine by me, but that's
a squid-fishing boat, right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... The sea really is wonderful.
Above all, I love how blue it is.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey SteGo, look over there!
A massive pile of driftwood washed ashore!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No way in hell we're letting this go to waste!
What should we make? A watchtower?
Or maybe a cozy dream home?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nah, dreams and puddings are best extra big!
We build a space elevator and go on a space vacation!
That's the play!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you always come up with the most entertaining ideas.
So, what do we need for that...?
First blueprints, and then fundraising—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, mmgh, what is this ticklish feeling...?
I'm supposed to be hanging out with a pal,
so why do I feel like I'm being watched over like a kid...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I didn't know you could make such a complicated face.
See, it really is good to meet up once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whose fault is that, huh? Whose?!
Man, you're impossible to deal with!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, complain all you like.
It's not every day that we get to hang out just the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...S-Soft! You're hitting me with that lukewarm gaze
like a bowl of soggy ramen!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's it, that's it! Closing shop for today!
Gonna eat, take a bath, dance ParaPara, and go to bed!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I ate like a rugby club after practice!
...Hey SteGo. Wanna go beetle hunting
one more time after th—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
SteGo? Ooooi, in the bathroom?
Huh, what's this note...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Hey Golshi. Sudden change of plans, I'm heading out on a journey.
Let's hang out again when I get back.
From Stay Gold"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah? That punk just up and left without saying a word.
Just how free-spirited can you get, sheesh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, she left cash for the food, so
I guess I'll let her off the hook!
